fact: ARCOP, the public procurement regulator, completed four training sessions on professional use of generative AI for its agents on 4 September 2026, covering document synthesis, legal comparison, audit and reporting work.
title: NOUVEAUX OUTILS POUR ALLEGER CERTAINES TACHES : A l'ARCOP, l'intelligence artificielle entre dans les pratiques de régulation
publisher: Autorité de Régulation de la Commande Publique (ARCOP)
